Information we collect
{app} does not require an account, and we do not collect, sell or share your personal information on our own servers.

Data on your device
Content you create, open or save in the app (such as files, settings and preferences) stays on your device.

Ads and third-party services
Some of our apps may show ads through Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers such as the advertising ID to serve and measure ads. See https://policies.google.com/privacy. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your Android settings.

Internet access
If the app loads online content, requests go directly from your device to the service that provides it. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Permissions
The app asks only for permissions needed for its features, such as access to files you choose to open.

Children
Our apps are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes and contact
We may update this policy and will change the date above. Questions: labsdevapps@gmail.com.

apps.policy_text:
Privacy Policy for Test App

Effective Date: November 14, 2026

Welcome to Test App ("we," "our," or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application.

1. Information We Collect
When you use Test App, we may collect the following types of information:
- Usage Data: Information about how you interact with the app, features used, and time spent.
- Device Information: Device type, operating system version, and unique device identifiers.
- Personal Data: If you choose to contact us or register, we may collect your name and email address.

2. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected information for the following purposes:
- To provide, maintain, and improve Test App.
- To analyze usage trends and enhance user experience.
- To respond to your inquiries, comments, or support requests.

3. Data Security
We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

4. Third-Party Services
Our app may contain links to third-party services or integrate with analytics tools. These third parties have their own privacy policies addressing how they use your information.

5. Children's Privacy
Test App does not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from children under the age of 13. If we learn that we have collected personal data from a child under 13, we will delete that information as quickly as possible.

6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page with a revised effective date.

7. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
- Email: support@testapp.com
